longctx._notes: Reads actual source files in round-robin interleaved order, capped at 50k tokens.

rag._notes: Retrieves top_k*4=20 candidates, re-ranks by source-priority heuristic, returns top 5.

iterative._notes: Structure-aware iterative reader with feasible local-model budget: reads up to 5 initial chunks, performs 1 bounded follow-up round over up to 3 chunks, extracts typed evidence-bound facts, and stops on typed evidence coverage/no-progress rather than model self-confidence.

judge._notes: Judge model should be stronger than answer_model. Replace placeholders with your chosen judge API (e.g., GPT-4o-mini via OpenAI API, or a larger local model). Example: model='gpt-4o-mini', base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1', api_key='sk-...'
